title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 9 October 2026
description: South Australia's new Royal Commission into AI and SpaceX's reported $40 billion raise for Nvidia chips, construction starting on the $1.8 billion Nolans rare earths project and a possible aurora tonight, Queensland's mining sector watching a High Court emissions ruling, and World Supercross axing its Gold Coast round plus unusually large bluebottles washing ashore. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
